mode.title: Choose interview mode
mode.subtitle: Your choice determines the level of support and how rounds are configured in the next step.

mode.description: Only one mode can be selected for each interview campaign.

mode.realTestDescription: No hints, default rounds based on the role, and evaluation that mirrors a real interview.

device.title: Device check
device.subtitle: Check your microphone and make a short test recording before entering the AI interview room.

device.allPassed: All required checks passed. You can continue to the interview room.
device.accuracyFailed: The reading was not accurate enough (Accuracy: {{accuracy}}%). Please try again.
device.readAgain: The recording was unclear or differed too much. Read the sample loudly and clearly, then record again.
device.sttFailed: The server could not process the recording. Please try again.
